public_copy_note: Preserve exact user-provided copy. No private names in on-image text.

slides.on_image_text: LOVE IS NOT LOVING ONE VERSION.
slides.visual_direction: A drawer/table with small objects from different eras: old movie ticket, key, bracelet, messy note, tiny photo strip. Aachu and Zuv are partly visible at the edge, not a direct pose.
slides.why: starts with a thought, not a scene copy

slides.visual_direction: early-date energy: two cups, nervous hands, Aachu mid-laugh, Zuv trying to look calm. Keep it close-up/detail-heavy.
moving boxes, changed plans, crossed-out calendar, new city/routine hints. Both are in motion, not sitting romantically.
slides.why: introduces tension. Change is the villain.

slides.visual_direction: one old plan or dream packed away, but not sadly. Maybe Aachu folds an outfit/old note while Zuv tapes a new label on a box.
slides.why: more adult, less generic we grow

slides.on_image_text: THE RIGHT PERSON LEARNS THE UPDATE.
slides.visual_direction: Zuv knows the new thing without making a speech; Aachu also adjusts something for him. Mutual care: two small actions happening in the same frame.
slides.why: emotional receipt; not he saves her, but we keep updating each other

slides.visual_direction: future echo only here. Young couple walking away from the table/room, older couple in the far background doing the same gesture. Subtle, not every slide.
slides.why: earns the lifelong feeling without copying forever/always language
